question: The sum of five numbers is 655. The average of the first two numbers is 80 and the third number is 109. Find the average of the remaining two numbers.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of remaining 2 numbers = Total sum − (Sum of first 2 numbers + Third number)

Sum = 655 − (80 × 2 + 109) = 655 − 269 = 386

Average of remaining 2 numbers = 386 ÷ 2 = 193

**∴ The correct answer is 193.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total sum of 5 numbers = 655

Average of the first 2 numbers = 80

The third number = 109

**Formula Used:**

Sum of numbers = Average × Number of items

Average = Sum of observations ÷ Number of observations

 
 Total Sum of 5 numbers = 655
 
 
• 
 
• 

 
 Sum = 160
 Avg = 80 (2 nos)

 
 109
 (3rd no)

 
 Sum = 655 − 269 = 386
 Avg = 386 ÷ 2 = 193

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of the first 2 numbers = 80 × 2 = 160

⇒ Sum of the first 3 numbers = 160 + 109 = 269

⇒ Sum of the remaining 2 numbers = Total sum − Sum of the first 3 numbers

⇒ Sum of the remaining 2 numbers = 655 − 269 = 386

⇒ Average of the remaining 2 numbers = 386 ÷ 2 = 193

**∴ The correct answer is 193.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average

When different groups have different averages, their combined average is calculated as (N₁A₁ + N₂A₂ + ...) ÷ (N₁ + N₂ + ...).

Change in Average

If a specific total is deducted from a group, the remaining sum distributed among the remaining items gives the new group average.
